# The tab overflow cap spec reserves one action, not the cluster

## Context

`dev` is red. The `Engine Tests` workflow's `components` job fails at `fa20136f29`, and the `workstation/` e2e directory carries a second red at the same base: `WorkstationTabOverflowCapNL` has been failing since `#17963`'s design pass (merged PR `#17977`) turned on the close/pin/maximize actions in `apps/workstation`.

Measured at `dev@fa20136f29`:

```
cap must derive from the rendered control width (extent 275.59375, control 24)
Expected: 251
Received: 203
```

Production is right and the spec is stale. This ticket corrects the spec.

## The Problem

`test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationTabOverflowCapNL.spec.mjs` asserts a single arithmetic identity for the cap the overflow plugin applies to a degenerate over-wide active tab button:

```js
expect(facts.capped.maxWidth).toBe(Math.floor(facts.toolbarRect.width) - Math.ceil(facts.control.width));
```

`floor(275.59) - ceil(24) = 251`. The plugin applied `203`. The delta is `48`, which is **exactly `2 × 24px`**.

That number is the whole diagnosis. The header toolbar no longer ends with one action. Measured live in the running app on the heavy `Priority Alert Observatory` header:

| action | width | `visibility` |
|---|---|---|
| `More tabs` (the overflow control) | 24px | visible |
| `maximize` | 24px | hidden (focus-gated, geometry preserved) |
| `close` | 24px | visible |

Cluster width `72px`, and `275 - 72 = 203` — the value the plugin actually wrote. **The plugin reserves the full trailing action cluster; the spec's formula reserves only the overflow control.** The formula was correct when the overflow control was the sole trailing action, which is the world `#16424` and `#17960` were written in.

**Every other assertion in the same test passes**, and that is what convicts the formula rather than the plugin:

- `capped.controlIx === 0` — the capped box has zero painted intersection with the control.
- `capped.rect.right <= control.left + 0.5` — the box ends at or before the control edge.
- the per-button indicator spans the capped box to within 1px.
- every pressed button's `ix === 0` — nothing paints beneath the control.

So the geometry the test exists to protect is intact. Only the identity that re-derives the number from one operand is wrong, and it now under-reserves by the width of the two actions the app gained.

Note the gated `maximize` is **counted**, correctly. The focus-gating carrier toggles interactivity while preserving geometry (`resources/scss/src/toolbar/Base.scss` — `visibility: hidden`, not `display: none`), so a quiet action still occupies its box and a tab running under it would still be covered. A repair that counted only visible actions would pass today and break the moment the pane takes focus.

## The Architectural Reality

- The reserve is computed from the rendered trailing cluster, not from a single control, because the tab-overflow plugin bounds the active button against whatever the toolbar's action partition actually occupies. The header action family (`#17945` pin, `#17953` maximize, `#17948` reload, `#17419` close, `#17960` overflow-as-first-action) made that partition variable per consumer and per opt-in flag.
- The spec's own comment states the intent correctly — *"the cap the plugin applied equals the toolbar extent minus the RENDERED control width — not the pre-creation estimate"*. The **rendered, not estimated** half is the load-bearing part and stays. Only the extent of "what is reserved" changed from one action to the cluster.
- `apps/workstation` is the staging ground: it is the app that both overflows a header and now enables the full engine set, so it is the only place this identity can be exercised end to end.

## The Fix

`test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationTabOverflowCapNL.spec.mjs` only. No production change.

1. Collect the trailing action cluster from the rendered toolbar — every `:scope > .neo-toolbar-action`, gated or not — and derive its extent from the DOM, not from a count times an assumed size.
2. Replace the single-operand identity with the cluster identity, keeping the rendered-not-estimated discipline.
3. Assert the cluster is **non-degenerate** (more than one action) so the repair cannot silently pass by collapsing back to the single-control case; and keep counting gated actions, with the reason written in the spec.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `WorkstationTabOverflowCapNL` cap identity | the tab-overflow plugin's applied `maxWidth` | re-derived from the rendered trailing action cluster | none — a stale identity is the defect | in-spec comment naming why gated actions count | green at `dev` head; the arithmetic reproduces `203` from measured DOM |

No production surface changes.

## Decision Record impact

`none`. Test-only correction.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `WorkstationTabOverflowCapNL` passes at the current `dev` head, with the cap identity re-derived from the rendered trailing action cluster rather than a single control.
- [ ] The cluster extent is measured from the DOM — not a hardcoded action count, and not a count multiplied by an assumed action size.
- [ ] Gated (`visibility: hidden`) actions are counted, with the reason written in the spec: the carrier preserves geometry, so a quiet action still occupies its box.
- [ ] A guard asserts the cluster holds more than one action, so the repair cannot pass by degenerating back to the single-control case it replaced.
- [ ] Every existing geometry assertion in the test is unchanged — the zero-intersection, edge, indicator-span and ellipsis checks are what the test is for, and they already pass.
- [ ] The `workstation/` e2e directory shows this spec green; `WorkstationStarvedGeometryNL` is expected to remain red and is out of scope (see below).

## Out of Scope

- **`WorkstationStarvedGeometryNL`** — the other red at the same base (`the taller box grows the row pool without frames`, expected `> 29`, received `29`). Different subject (renderer starvation / row pool), needs its own measurement and its own ticket.
- **`DockReload.spec.mjs:181`** — the `components` job's red. A Playwright strict-mode violation (`resolved to 2 elements`), so tab-bar arity, not this. Tracked against #17980's subject; the production side is mine via #17948.
- Any change to the tab-overflow plugin. Its geometry is correct and every geometric assertion already proves it.
- Whether the engine action set should be reservable per-action rather than as a cluster — a design question no measurement here raises.

## Avoided Traps

- **Loosening the assertion to a tolerance.** A `toBeCloseTo` would go green and stop testing the thing the identity exists for: that the cap is re-derived from render truth rather than an estimate. The identity stays exact; only its operand is corrected.
- **Counting only visible actions.** Passes today, breaks the moment a pane takes focus and the gated actions become visible — and it would silently re-introduce the covered-tab defect `#16424` was filed for, because a gated action still occupies its box.
- **Hardcoding `3` or `72`.** The action count is per-consumer and per-flag; the next opt-in would re-red it. Measure the cluster.
- **Fixing it in the plugin.** The plugin produced the correct number. Changing production to satisfy a stale test is the inversion this ticket exists to avoid.
